mlx-oq4e-mtp.notes: Sage S2.1 Flash (#2466): oQ4e mixed-precision MLX conversion of internlm/Sage-S2.1-Flash at 76f4513d (oMLX 0.8.0rc1; 4-bit g64 routed experts, 8-bit g64 attention, shared experts, dense MLP, embeddings and output head; BF16 vision encoder; embedded MTP layer), published by Hygaard. Same glm5_next architecture (Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration, one next-N layer) and tokenizer.json (LFS 19e77364) as zai-org/glm-5.3-flash. 71 files: 35 model shards (186,402,463,963 bytes, 475,791,676 more than the zai-org/glm-5.3-flash shards) plus nine FP32 scientific projector safetensors the text engine does not load. min_ram_gb = the zai-org/glm-5.3-flash 234 (200 GB measured native peak at 64k + 4 GB for 4 CB slots of 64k paged state + 26 GB SPEC-048-R012 10% free-memory floor on 256 GB + 4 GB safety margin) + 1 GB for the larger weights = 235. Snapshot-manifest hash recomputed from the Hugging Face API at the pinned revision with scripts/catalog-hash-sweep.py's algorithm; it equals the target_sha256 of the Studio intake runs, whose fetch step verified every file's LFS SHA-256 or git blob SHA-1.
